notes: «وَ رُوِيَ عَنْ» is passive: the first link is علي بن جعفر.
«عن أخيه موسى بن جعفر» is one link (rule 7) and an Imam inside the chain after «عن»: narrator. «سألته» refers back to him, adds no link.

«رُوِيَ عَنْ علي بن جعفر عَنْ أَخِيهِ موسى» is one route: «أخيه» plus a name is one link (rule 7), the name alone is the surface
«قال: سألته» names no new person: the one asked is the Imam already written in the chain; the saying («أعتق من أغنى نفسه») is his answer
